name: Color Chaos
description: Collaborative numbered coloring game for TikTok LIVE - viewers comment a region number plus a color; gifts fire color power-ups.

effects.premium_color: apply a premium color (gold/neon/rainbow) to a region
effects.multi_fill: fill several uncolored regions at once
effects.clear_region: clear one region back to white
effects.rename_region: label a region with the gifter's name
effects.rainbow_sweep: fill a series of regions with random colors
